Enforce effective blockers across execution boundaries (#149)

codeon:
  version: 1
  authority: fewensa-40
  description: |-
    ## Summary
    - Consume the canonical effective-blocker projection at Picker filtering, claim recheck, and Admission so Parent Package blockers block eligibility the same way Direct blockers do.
    - Freeze deduplicated Direct/Parent provenance on Admission snapshot blocker rows and include non-Direct provenance in the dispatchability fingerprint while keeping Direct-only evidence byte-identical.
    - Block late Task/Package finalization and Package aggregation auto-Done across unsatisfied effective blockers, with focused candidate, admission, and claim/mutation race coverage.
    
    ## Test plan
    - [x] `cargo test -p codeon-tracker --lib` (562 passed)
    - [x] `cargo check -p codeon-tracker -p codeon-postgres -p codeon --features postgres-acceptance`
    - [ ] `just test-postgres` for `issue_blockers`, `picker_candidates`, and `execution_attempt_store` when `CODEON_TEST_DATABASE_URL` is available
